commits.message:
Feature/gh aw 3 (#763)

* Add protected-files fallback handling to workflow

Update sync_open_prs_with_main workflow to avoid pushing changes to protected files. Adds protected_files_policy: "fallback-to-issue" to GH_AW_SAFE_OUTPUTS_HANDLER_CONFIG in the lock file, and documents the new protected-files: fallback-to-issue option and fallback behavior in the workflow README. Also updates the workflow lock metadata (frontmatter hash). This ensures merges that would modify protected files create an issue instead of force-pushing changes to PR branches.

* Add triage_incoming_bug_reports workflow lockfile

Add a new GitHub Actions workflow for triaging incoming bug reports (.github/workflows/triage_incoming_bug_reports.md) and its compiled lockfile (.github/workflows/triage_incoming_bug_reports.lock.yml). The lockfile was auto-generated by gh-aw (v0.62.5) and provisions a full agent pipeline using the GitHub Copilot CLI: setup, safe-outputs MCP server, MCP gateway, agent execution, threat detection, artifact upload, and conclusion steps (comments/labels/discussions). DO NOT EDIT the lockfile directly — update the .md source and run `gh aw compile` as noted in the generated header.

* Add changelog workflow documentation

Remove the existing auto_change_log.yml workflow and add auto_change_log.md documenting the changelog automation. The new markdown describes goals and step-by-step behavior for generating CHANGELOG.md with git-chglog, smart diff detection to avoid timestamp-only PR noise, branch/PR conventions, required PR body content, triggers (release, push on main, workflow_dispatch), permissions, and constraints. This commit moves the workflow implementation details into a readable spec for the automation and documents installation/usage notes and expected behavior.

* Add update_docker_netsnmp_versions workflow

Add a new gh-aw-generated workflow (update_docker_netsnmp_versions.md/.lock.yml) that schedules and runs an agent to update Docker Net-SNMP versions, including safe-outputs config (title prefix [docker-netsnmp-update]) and full activation/agent/detection/conclusion steps. Also trim automated PR labels for the coverage-autofix workflow: remove the additional labels (coverage, tests, cpp, python) in both the .md and the compiled .lock.yml, and update the gh-aw metadata hash in the compiled coverage lock file.

@@ -0,0 +1,104 @@
+---
+name: Update Docker Net-SNMP Versions
+concurrency:
+  group: ${{ github.workflow }}
+  cancel-in-progress: false
+on:
+  workflow_dispatch:
+    inputs:
+      include_prerelease:
+        description: "Include pre-release Net-SNMP tags (pre/rc/beta/alpha)"
+        required: false
+        default: false
+        type: boolean
+  schedule: weekly on saturday
+  skip-if-match:
+    query: 'is:pr is:open head:automation/update-docker-netsnmp-versions label:dependencies label:docker label:automated-pr'
+permissions:
+  actions: read
+  contents: read
+safe-outputs:
+  create-pull-request:
+    title-prefix: "[docker-netsnmp-update] "
+    labels: [dependencies, docker, automated-pr]
+    draft: false
+    preserve-branch-name: true
+    if-no-changes: "ignore"
+timeout-minutes: 45
+engine:
+  id: copilot
+  model: auto
+network:
+  allowed: [defaults, github]
+tools:
+  edit:
+  bash: true
+---
+
+# Update Docker Net-SNMP Patch Versions
+
+Discover upstream Net-SNMP releases and update Docker-pinned Net-SNMP versions
+with safe, track-aware rules.
+
+## Schedule Behavior
+
+- If triggered by `workflow_dispatch`, run immediately.
+- If triggered by `schedule`, run once per Saturday using gh-aw fuzzy scheduling.
+
+## Goals
+
+- Track upstream Net-SNMP releases from the `net-snmp/net-snmp` source.
+- Update only patch versions within currently pinned `major.minor` tracks.
+- Avoid risky cross-track upgrades (example: do not auto-jump `5.7.x` to `5.9.x`).
+- Default to stable releases only, excluding pre-release channels unless explicitly opted in.
+
+## Steps
+
+1. Discover currently pinned Net-SNMP versions in repository Docker assets:
+   - Scan `docker/**/Dockerfile`, `docker/**/README.rst`, and `docker/cache/download_build_cache.sh`.
+   - Extract explicit version strings from patterns like:
+     - `net-snmp-<x.y.z>.tar.gz`
+     - textual version mentions such as `Net-SNMP <x.y.z>`
+
+2. Determine latest upstream versions for each detected `major.minor` track:
+  - Use both upstream tags and releases data from `net-snmp/net-snmp`.
+  - Normalize tags (for example strip a leading `v` if present) before version comparison.
+  - Determine latest by semantic version first, and use release/tag date as tie-break context when needed.
+  - By default, exclude pre-release tags and versions such as `.pre*`, `-rc*`, `-beta*`, `-alpha*` and release entries marked `prerelease=true`.
+  - Only include pre-release channels when `workflow_dispatch` input `include_prerelease` is `true`.
+   - Build a map such as:
+     - track `5.7` -> latest upstream `5.7.z`
+     - track `5.8` -> latest upstream `5.8.z`
+     - track `5.9` -> latest upstream `5.9.z`
+
+3. Apply safe updates:
+   - For each pinned version, if a newer patch exists in the same track, update references.
+   - Keep all edits strictly to Net-SNMP version references.
+   - Update corresponding tarball names and directory names where versioned paths are used.
+
+4. Validate impact:
+   - Ensure replacements are consistent and no mixed-version references remain for files touched.
+   - If no version bumps are needed, stop with a no-op summary.
+
+5. If changes exist, create or update one PR using:
+   - Branch: `automation/update-docker-netsnmp-versions`
+   - Base: `main`
+   - Title: `Update Docker Net-SNMP patch versions`
+   - Commit message: `chore(docker): update Net-SNMP patch versions in Docker assets`
+
+## Pull Request Body
+
+Include:
+
+- Upstream source checked (`net-snmp/net-snmp`)
+- Selection mode used (`stable-only` or `include-prerelease`)
+- Detected tracks and old/new patch versions per track
+- Files changed
+- Explicit note that only patch-level, same-track updates were performed
+
+## Scope
+
+- Restrict edits to Net-SNMP version references in Docker-related files.
+- Keep default behavior on stable releases only unless `include_prerelease=true` was explicitly provided.
+- Do not change Python versions, distro versions, workflow logic, or unrelated code.
+- If upstream data is ambiguous or unavailable, stop with no-op and explain why.
